description: This file contains functions and setup scripts for the MBIM protocol in a network interface context, particularly within the OpenWrt embedded Linux environment. It includes functions to initialize configuration, set up the protocol, gather specific fields from modem configurations, and manage connection lifecycle including connect, disconnect, and configuration updates.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes protocol configuration options and parameters for MBIM.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from the modem's MBIM configuration output.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM protocol by invoking the internal setup function and handling retries.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Stops the network interface and disconnects the modem, cleaning up state.
